# Feature: Business Metrics

## Overview
Create a comprehensive metrics system that tracks and visualizes key business performance indicators across all aspects of operations.

## User Stories

1. Revenue Analytics
   - As a business owner
   - I want to track revenue metrics
   - So I can monitor financial performance

2. Service Analytics
   - As a manager
   - I want to analyze service performance
   - So I can optimize our offerings

3. Staff Metrics
   - As a business owner
   - I want to monitor staff performance
   - So I can identify areas for improvement

4. Customer Insights
   - As a manager
   - I want to see customer metrics
   - So I can understand client behavior

5. Trend Analysis
   - As a business owner
   - I want to see trend analysis
   - So I can make informed decisions

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create metrics calculation engine
- [ ] Implement visualization system
- [ ] Build trend analyzer
- [ ] Create comparison tools
- [ ] Implement goal tracking
- [ ] Add custom metrics
- [ ] Create export functionality
- [ ] Implement data filters
- [ ] Add scheduled reports
- [ ] Create alerting system

## Acceptance Criteria
- Metrics calculate accurately
- Visualizations render properly
- Trends analyze correctly
- Comparisons work effectively
- Goals track properly
- Custom metrics work
- Exports generate properly
- Reports deliver on schedule

## Technical Notes
- Use analytics engine
- Implement proper aggregation
- Use background jobs for calculations
- Cache metric results
- Follow data analysis patterns
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 13
- Time Estimate: 1.5 weeks

## Dependencies
- Dashboard Overview feature
- Data warehouse system
